# Construct the backup and mbox summary filename before direct database opening

The database path migration requires callers of the direct service API to pass the actual .msf path. In accepted source, OpenBackupMsgDatabase resolves backupDBDummyFolder through GetSummaryFileLocation before OpenDBFromFile. The mbox folder-copy path converts newPath into newDBFile through the same helper before opening destDB. Preserve these caller conversions together with their error checks; passing the storage path would identify a different file. The general direct-open filename boundary and matching OpenInternal summaryFile declaration/definition are already shared in the correction record. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.

Scope: Direct message database path contract.
